Priya: ```
ACTIONS:
- A1: router retry hotpath fix — owner: ? — due: ?
- A2: model-fallback canary + policy — owner: ? — due: ?
- A3: runbook + postmortem writeup edits — owner: ? — due: ?
- A4: Dedicated autoscale load test + tuning — owner: ? — due: ?
- A5: customer outreach template + seg list — owner: ? — due: ?
```
Alex: I'll take A1. ETA Wed 2026-03-18. Will open PR and ping @Jamal for review.
Jamal: Ack. I'll review once Alex posts. Note A4 likely depends on eng-infra providing the perf VM; @Sasha can you confirm scheduling?

Morgan: I'll do A3 (runbook). ETA 2026-03-19. Will attach the diff and link the postmortem doc.
Priya: Please update the shared doc and add ticket IDs. If any cross-team dependency, mark it as BLOCKED and add the owner inline.
inc-bot: New ticket created: INC-832-A1 -> https://redwood.atlassian/INC-832-A1 (assigned to Alex).

Priya: Pinging ModelOps now. If no reply by Tue noon, we'll schedule a 30m sync.
Sasha: ModelOps tentatively approved the high-level approach but require telemetry gating. New action A6: telemetry + metrics to gate fallback. I'll own A6, ETA 2026-03-24.
Morgan: For A5 (customer outreach), can @Elaine from Support review messaging and segs?
Elaine: I can review and prep the template. Prefer release-ready copy by 2026-03-20.
Priya: OK final summary for the thread (please confirm or update):
- A1: Alex — due 2026-03-18
- A2: unassigned (requires ModelOps sign-off)
- A3: Morgan — due 2026-03-19
- A4: Sasha — due 2026-03-22
- A5: Elaine — due 2026-03-20

Anyone disagree or need alternate ETA?
Alex: fine.
Jamal: fine.
Sasha: good.
